title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot! — Episode5 A Rival Appears!

meta.Event Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: One hour later
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
The photo we just took is in tenth place now...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And everyone's commenting on how cool you look, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm a little embarrassed, but this wouldn't have been possible without either of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd like to think it's the result of our great teamwork.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting it to do this well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This ability to share your thoughts about the entries you like with others online may be having a bigger effect than we realized.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We might actually win that prize if this keeps up...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But the rankings are changing really fast because of all the last-minute entries. If possible, I'd like to see ours rise a little higher.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me too.
Why don't we post a second photo if we think it can do better?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! There's a lot of nice spots around here, maybe we can change up—

Hey, I dunno if I hold this pose.
My legs are really starting to wobble.
You are basically doing a wall sit...

Just a little bit longer, Ena!
The light's coming through the trees and leaves is hitting your face just right!
O-Okay, but you need to hurry...!
Alright, smile...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi! Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
T-Toya?!
What are you...? Wah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh no! Ena, are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I got so startled that I lost my balance...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: More importantly, Toya, what are you doing here? Wait, Azusawa, Kiritani, you're here too...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait a second...! Those clothes, that camera...! Were you guys taking photos for that contest?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Kohane & Toya
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, how do you know about the photo contest...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because she's in it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She is?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was wondering why Toya's picture turned out so well. I didn't realize you were helping him, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Did you take this photo, Kohane?
We were all surprised by how good it looked.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But our next one is gonna be better!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, the pic I took got leapfrogged by the one of Toya you guys took.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I didn't know you also entered...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You don't have to apologize...
But I'm taking back my place in the rankings!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're helping her with a new entry, so don't think this is over yet!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds like we've got a heated rivalry on our hands.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not going to back down either...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, let's...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, what if we tried taking one with these flowers?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, they're so pretty.
Just like you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But they're a little too low to the ground. Getting them in the same frame won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. Even if you sat next to them, I'm not sure how that would look overall.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, why don't I try lying down...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, good call!
Taking the photo is gonna look a little funny, but that won't matter if we can get it to work! Let's give it a try...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, what if we had some petals fall towards you while you're on the ground? Imagine how wondrous that would look!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, that's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's start gathering up some of these petals.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, I blinked... The sun's just so bright...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree that it might be a little too bright here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, we can try taking it the other way around.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The other way around? So, the sun would be behind me? That'd certainly help me, but the backlight might be...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You can take really pretty photos if you know how to use it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you lower the shutter speed just right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow, that's incredible...
The way his hair and clothes are being bathed in sunlight is so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Plus, the contrast between light and dark gives it depth. It really helps pull in the viewer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, but the shadow over his face looks a little too dark. I'll try taking the next one from a slightly different angle.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our second one isn't getting many likes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I thought it was just as good as our first one, but our luck and timing may not have been...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not to mention all the other entries coming in at the last minute. Our second one may've been swept away by that tide.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And our first one's lost its spot...
That means we'll need to turn things around with our third one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How are things going, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, hi! What are you all doing back...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We came to see how you guys were doing after uploading our second pic.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it looks like you're kinda stuck.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it just isn't that easy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If only there were a way for me to pose better...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm...?
If you're going with that pose, Aoyagi, you may want to lower your chin a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's perfect.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, why are you helping them?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
I'm so sorry.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If anything, I should be the one apologizing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Momoi.
I didn't mean to place Hinomori in a position where she felt compelled to give me advice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, wait...!
Now I'm starting to feel bad about what I just said!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Geez, you two are way too polite...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-By the way, Ena, can I see your latest photo...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. Just gimme a sec to bring it up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, check it out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... You look so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And all these flower petals! They're beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
We worked hard for this one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We gathered up as many petals as we could and used a fan to blow them around. You wouldn't believe how hard it was to take this picture while doing all that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
You all put quite a lot of effort for this one photo.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm impressed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: B-But I'm guessing it's easy for professional idols like you to strike a pose and smile at the camera...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's not true.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The way your eyes glisten and how delicate your fingers look... This is the sort of cuteness that I'd want to enshrine somewhere forever.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You seem to know exactly what you want the person on the other side to see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I heard from Airi that you're very good at taking selfies, but this goes beyond that. Again, I'm impressed.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: M-My eyes...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
W-What just happened...?!
I thought my heart was gonna explode...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this is what Haruka can do in default mode. Just some food for thought.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I think I'm starting to get why Minori's such a huge fan...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The photo Ena and the other's just took is skyrocketing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(And it should be getting a lot of likes.
I mean, it's just so gorgeous.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, it's already ahead of our second one. At this rate, our first one's also going to be...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Don't worry...
We still have a chance. We're allowed to take one more.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And we're going to get into the top ten no matter what!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because I want An and Shinonome to have those chocolates...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which means I have to take something better than what Ena and the other's just did...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're not giving up just yet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uhh... Our next photo is going to be even better than the one you all just took! Just you wait...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which means we also need to keep doing our best, Airi, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Right!
